newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Philippines President to visit Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Philippines President to visit Bangladesh.

text.p: Philippines President Fidel Ramos arrives in Dhaka on Wednesday for a three-day visit to Bangladesh that officials said would mainly focus on trade and economic cooperation.
Ramos, the first Filipino president to visit Bangladesh, would be accompanied by more than 100 top traders and investors, foreign ministry officials said on Monday.
He would meet Bangladesh President Shahabuddin Ahmed, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and a number of ministers.

"Bangladesh and the Philippines can both benefit from closer economic cooperation," one official said, adding that Dhaka would explore prospects of participation by Filipino investors in a variety of fields.
Shortly after Ramos's visit, Vietnamese Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet would arrive in Bangladesh on March 9 for a two-day visit, the officials said.
The Vietnamese leader would be accompanied by his foreign minister and a business delegation, which would have a series of meetings with Bangladesh trade and business leaders.
Vo Van Kiet would have talks with Prime Minister Hasina on strengthening all-round bilateral ties, officials said.

"Dhaka and Hanoi can forge stronger cooperation as both are emerging economic powers in Asia, and can greatly contribute to each other's efforts," a foreign ministry official said without elaborating.
The two countries were expected to set up a joint commission for promoting economic relations during Vo Van Kiet's visit.
President Suleyman Demirel of Turkey was expected to arrive Dhaka on March 25 to attend Bangladesh's independence anniversary on March 26, officials said.
They said details of the Turkish president's visit were still being worked out.
